plugins.name: task
plugins.description: Markdown task management: task files with an embedded workflow table that is the state, epics with sub-tasks and an O(1) epic index, atomic lock-guarded ID allocation safe across parallel sessions, and scripted listing — filters, grouping, epic views with closed work collapsed. Runtime-free (bash + awk); storage location is per-project.

plugins.name: session-storage
plugins.description: Session-scoped key-value storage for Claude Code. Store and retrieve data tied to individual sessions with automatic cleanup.

plugins.name: docs-manager
plugins.description: Treat docs as a product: auto-generated _index.md navigation, broken-link checks, text-source diagrams with typed refs and staleness tracking, a how-to for drawing ERDs that hold up, a method for keeping an agent instruction file (CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md) small by moving project knowledge into the docs, cards that catalogue external reference files (pdf, docx, xlsx) with where-to-look maps, runtime-free docx/xlsx extraction, staleness checks that name the docs to review, and the docs-as-product conventions. No renderer, no runtime, no dependencies.

plugins.name: task-roadmap
plugins.description: Abstract-Gantt roadmap for a markdown task set: scheduled by dependencies and estimates, grouped by epic, critical path highlighted; self-contained HTML, auto-regenerated on task changes.

plugins.name: delay
plugins.description: Delay long-running jobs, such as slow autotest suites, to the user's run window on a Mac: Claude queues an approved job by name only and reminds the user to start the runner; the user's sudo start.sh schedules a pmset wake and loads the runner, which runs the jobs in each project's own docker container with the screen locked, keeps the results, and unloads itself (no always-on daemon). Jobs, their sha256-pinned confinement and the window are set by a human with sudo. Runtime-free (bash + awk); macOS + launchd.
